tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Keyword search of published, in-stock surplus listings. No sign-in required. `query` matches the name, description, brand, SKU, and category words, in any order. If the whole query is a category (electronics, clothes, home goods), it is treated as that category filter. Pass `category` as a catalogue

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Read one listing: description, price, quantity, condition, photo, and whether instant checkout is available. No sign-in required. Use this before requesting a quote or buying. Pass the exact id from search, for example product_2731.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask a seller to price a bulk order. No sign-in required if you pass buyer_email, which is where the seller replies. buyer_email is always required, including when you are signed in. Anonymous requests are limited to 5 per hour. Sign in with buyer access to attach the quote to your account. Save stat

tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Check a quote you requested: pending, responded, accepted, rejected, or completed, plus the seller price and shipping once they reply. No sign-in required when you pass the status_token from request_quote. Signed-in buyers can also read their own quotes without the token.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Publish a surplus lot for sale. Requires sign-in with seller access. Provide a title, category, condition, quantity, and price per unit. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

tools.name: get_pricing_recommendation
tools.description: Suggest a liquidation unit price in cents from MSRP, condition, category, and lot size. No sign-in required. original_retail is MSRP per unit in cents. Larger lots suggest a lower per-unit price. The result is bounded below retail. This does not change any listing's price.

tools.name: get_quote_requests
tools.description: List quote requests buyers sent you. Requires sign-in with seller access. Filter to pending, responded, or all.

tools.name: respond_to_quote
tools.description: Answer a quote from a buyer by accepting it, sending a counter-price, or declining. Requires sign-in with seller access. The buyer is notified. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

tools.name: bulk_update_listings
tools.description: Change the price or the minimum order quantity on up to 200 of your listings. Requires sign-in with seller access. price_set takes price_cents (integer cents). value_usd is an explicit dollar amount and is deprecated. The percent modes adjust the current price, and moq_set writes a minimum order qua

tools.name: bulk_mark_shipped
tools.description: Mark up to 200 of your orders as shipped, with an optional tracking number, tracking link, and carrier applied to the whole batch. Requires sign-in with seller access. Tracking you supply replaces tracking already on those orders, and each buyer is notified. Sensitive: requires user approval each ti

tools.name: bulk_export_orders
tools.description: Download your orders as CSV, with order id, product, buyer, quantity, total, status, and date. Requires sign-in with seller access. Only orders you own are included.

tools.name: seller_inbox_summarise
tools.description: Summarise your seller inbox: quotes waiting for a reply, orders that may miss their ship-by date, and orders with reported problems. Requires sign-in with seller access. Use it to decide what to answer or ship next.

tools.name: quick_buy
tools.description: Start instant checkout for one listing. The listing's seller sells the goods. ForthClear runs the marketplace and Stripe processes the payment. Requires sign-in with buyer purchase access. buyer_email is required. quantity must be a positive integer below the listing's quote threshold (quote_quantit

tools.name: search_inventory_semantic
tools.description: Find listings by describing what you want in everyday language, such as returned kitchen appliances in bulk. No sign-in required. Semantic matches include similarity from 0 to 1 and match_type semantic. When the embedding index is empty or no provider is configured, results use keyword search, simil

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Check status, tracking, and the inspection deadline for an order you placed. Requires sign-in with buyer access.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Report a problem with an order. not_received is allowed while the order is marked shipped. Other reasons require a delivered order waiting for confirmation. This records the issue, pauses the seller payout, and notifies ForthClear. Requires sign-in with buyer access. Sensitive: requires user approva

tools.name: subscribe_to_query
tools.description: Save a catalogue search and receive new matching listings by email, webhook, or a pollable feed. Requires sign-in with buyer access.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Search the supplier directory. No sign-in required. Returns published company profiles only, including profiles a company has claimed. These are not lots for sale. A profile is compiled from public sources and is not an endorsement. Use search_inventory to find lots you can buy. Filter with query, c

tools.name: preview_checkout
tools.description: Read the seller of record, unit price, shipping, tax, and total for an instant-checkout listing. Does not charge a card. Requires buyer read access. Pass the returned checkout_id to confirm_purchase.

tools.name: confirm_purchase
tools.description: Charge the previewed checkout. Uses a Stripe shared payment token when the SDK supports it, otherwise the buyer's saved card, off session. Charges of US$1,000 or more return requires_action and a URL for 3-D Secure. Returns confirmed only after the PaymentIntent succeeds and the order exists. Fails

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: List orders the signed-in buyer placed. Requires buyer read access.

tools.name: list_seller_orders
tools.description: List orders for the signed-in seller. Requires seller read access. Returns order id, status, quantity, and total. Buyer contact details stay on the order page.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an unshipped order whose ship-by date has passed, for a full refund. Seller Agreement §5.4. Requires buyer purchase access. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

tools.name: mark_order_received
tools.description: Mark a shipped order received. This starts the 3-day inspection window and does not pay the seller. Requires buyer write access.

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: End the inspection window after it has elapsed. A live order then starts the seller payout. A sandbox order is marked delivered and is not paid out. Requires buyer write access.

tools.name: get_dispute_status
tools.description: Read the claim on an order you placed. Requires buyer read access.

tools.name: list_my_quotes
tools.description: List quote requests for the signed-in buyer. Requires buyer read access.

tools.name: accept_quote_and_pay
tools.description: Accept a seller's quoted price and charge it with the same payment options as confirm_purchase. Requires buyer purchase access. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_dispute, subscribe_to_query · Private data: get_quote_status, open_dispute, preview_checkout, confirm_purchase, list_seller_orders · Public sink: create_listing, subscribe_to_query.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_dispute, subscribe_to_query · Private data: get_quote_status, open_dispute, preview_checkout, confirm_purchase, list_seller_orders · Public sink: create_listing, subscribe_to_query

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
